key.name: schema-version
key.description: Used to migrate stored topics and sessions between versions.

key.name: topics
key.description: JSON array of {id, name, minutes, color, hidden, order, dailyGoalMinutes}.

key.name: seeded
key.description: Set once the default topics have been added, so they are not re-added after the user deletes them.

key.name: timers
key.description: JSON map of topic id to timer state. At most one timer is running; the others are paused.

key.name: purge-topic-ids
key.summary: Topics whose history should be deleted
key.description: Written by the preferences window before it deletes a topic with "Delete with History". The shell drops the topic's timer without logging it, removes its sessions and clears this list.

key.name: last-topic-id
key.description: Topic started by the shortcut when no timer is active.

key.name: sound-enabled
key.summary: Play a sound when a timer finishes

key.name: notifications-enabled
key.summary: Show a notification when a timer finishes

key.name: panel-show-countdown
key.summary: Show the topic and countdown in the top panel

key.name: week-start
key.summary: First day of the week for weekly stats

key.name: auto-chain-enabled
key.summary: Start another topic automatically when a timer finishes

key.name: auto-chain-from
key.summary: Topic IDs that trigger the auto-chain

key.name: auto-chain-to
key.summary: Topic ID started by the auto-chain
